svg.title: Cadence must satisfy drift, evidence age and lost observing time
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Cadence must satisfy drift, evidence age and lost observing time
Error envelope includes acquisition midpoint and processing latency
Science is unavailable throughout each dedicated calibration burst
At C = 10 s, d = 0.2 s: age ≤ 10.15 s; error ≤ 0.00806 rad; downtime 2%.
Drift bound and calibration-error envelopes are inputs requiring physical evidence.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
